title: ID0449189-DC/Si-D/CH- [Y2/S5 313659082001] Charger out of service
description:
Reported behavior/issue:  Customer complain about "charger is out of service". We rebooted
the EcoG and also the chareger itself but it is going in failsafemode.
Can you please investigate. Unfortunately, i dont have a technician
available the next days. Maybe we can fix it via remote.

additional_info.subject: RE: AW: AW: ID0449189-DC/Si-D/CH- [Y2/S5 313659082001] Charger out of service CRM:00472000391
additional_info.body:
Hello Alexander,
I took a look in the past ticket belonging to this charger. The behavior was exactly what we face during the ExpertNow intervention. Charger was in failsafe mode, which means one of mandatory devices was not communicating during the boot process.
At that time, both routers were replaced but I don't understand why. There is no indication on what was the troubleshooting process. After my intervention we know now that the problem was on the Ethernet cable, so doesn't matter if you replaced the router, the issue was still there. And like I noticed before the intervention when accessing the router remotely, there was times that the router 2 was working and would suddenly stop working. This is one expected behavior on a defective Ethernet cable. So if my colleague never saw this happening and after his intervention charger was online, charging and not showing signs of any other malfunctions, he didn't investigate the issue further.
Second totally different topic was what happen today that both Ecogs had a ModBus communication failure that was gone after rebooting the charger. Both problems are not related at all.
The charger is operational, I don't see what would you need to bring to Product Champion or R&D. I suggest to close this ticket since there is no pending action from service side.
Let me know if you agree I will wait for your feedback.
Thank you.
With best regards,
Joao Francisco Louro Cardoso
Siemens S.A.
SI E CS SD L3
201, Avenida 25 de Abril
2845-547 Corroios, Portugal
mailto:joao.louro-cardoso@siemens.com
www.siemens.com
